title: Pink Halloween Trick or Treat Porch Essentials
intro: My porch went pink for Halloween. A light up pumpkin bucket, a ghost candy bowl with a bow, glowing pumpkin lights, little pink pumpkins and ghost treat bags for the trick or treaters. Sweet instead of scary.

images.alt: Flat lay of pink Halloween porch essentials: light up pink pumpkin candy bucket, pink ghost candy bowl, pumpkin string lights, small pink faux pumpkins and ghost treat bags.
A woman on a cozy porch at dusk with pink pumpkin string lights, small pink pumpkins, a ghost candy bowl and a light up pumpkin bucket, holding a glitter pink iced coffee tumbler.
